title: Ideas on the project map
brief: Attach ideas to a project map. Ideas have implementing and not-implementing statuses and a discussion drawer.
arch: A local tree of questions with a discussion on each card.

nodes.answer: Let's drop implementing and not implementing. Ideas use open, closed, weak, gap and verify, just like questions.

nodes.q: Who switches the idea into implementing, and does that start code changes?

nodes.answer: Deferred until the next planning cycle.

chat.text: Keep my reasoning about why deferral was useful.

nodes.q: When is an idea saved if the drawer is closed?
